output.residual_limitation_note: This checks inclusion and local range-consistency of the ONE leaf and its proof path only. It does not and cannot prove every other leaf in the tree obeyed the same range check — only the tree operator's own construction process (or a full ZK proof over the whole tree, which this tool does not implement) can guarantee that globally. This is never a statement that the reserve is solvent.
output.verify_only_note: Verify-only: this tool reports "this leaf's inclusion in the published tree is verified" or "verification failed: <reason>" — never "reserves are sufficient", "solvent", or an audit opinion.
